method: Only earlier state governor polls vs actual governor results. D-R error = poll margin minus actual margin. Latest 3 same-state governor errors weighted 0.5/0.3/0.2; 1 historical event is shrunk to one-third, 2 events to two-thirds, 3 events to full. No federal-election inputs, no future election results.
caveats: Nonrandom 2018–24 sourced cohort with heterogeneous poll coverage and ballot designs. Single late and 41-day-old polling is weak evidence, particularly NE; 270toWin multi-poll reconstructions are not published publisher averages. Alaska candidate shares are first-choice in multi-candidate elections, not final RCV rounds. Single stale surveys are excluded. A race with one historical cycle can receive a shrunk 2026 correction but does not provide a past-only holdout score. No calibrated 2026 win chances.
